metadata.sampleType: Complete Official NJ MOD-IV Class 2 Residential Assessment Roll (14,360 Homes)
metadata.disclaimer: Contains all 14,360 Class 2 residential properties (1–4 family homes, townhouses, and condominiums) in Township of Parsippany-Troy Hills directly from the official State of New Jersey MOD-IV assessment roll (District 1429). All figures (Block, Lot, Qualifier, PAMS PIN, Assessed Land, Assessed Improvement, Total Net Assessment, Prior Certified Tax Billed, Year Built, Lot Size, Building Description, and Deed Sale Records) reflect official municipal tax records without synthetic interpolation.
